question: According to the Census of India 2011, identify the correct pair of State and Union Territories which recorded the highest literacy rate.
solution:
The correct answer is **Kerala and Lakshadweep**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** recorded the highest literacy rate among states in India as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• **Lakshadweep** recorded the highest literacy rate among the Union Territories.
 
• The literacy rate in Kerala was approximately **94%**.
 
• The literacy rate in Lakshadweep was around **91%**.
 
• Both regions have consistently high literacy rates due to effective educational policies and initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Literacy Rate** is a crucial indicator of a region's educational attainment. It is defined as the percentage of people aged seven years and above who can read and write with understanding.
